subject: Commercial path triage: PO requirement + onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@clearview.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Tom — thanks again for the time this morning. Short recap and action items from our side: 

- Scope: 10 seats initially for inference API (text gen + embeddings) for internal analytics workflows; expected monthly token volume ~ 12M tokens.
- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement prefers issuing a PO vs card; that works for us but we need to confirm contracting timeline and whether you want to route via your cloud marketplace listing.
- Compliance ask: a copy of your SOC2 contact and expected data residency (we noted US region).

Action items: 
1) Tom / Procurement: confirm PO routing and billing contact, and whether Clearview requires a vendor questionnaire answered (e.g., shared security checklist).
2) Alex (CC): I'll share a draft SOW and a marketplace link we can use if you prefer procurement via your vendor portal.
3) Me (Ben): propose a one-hour procurement/finance sync next week if helpful.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft-20261004.pdf (draft SOW), redwood-mktplace-listing-link.txt

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@clearview.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearview.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Thanks Ben — solid recap. A few notes from procurement side: 

- Confirmation: we will go PO for the initial term and renewals. Finance needs vendor setup (W-9, bank ACH) and a signed contract before issuing the PO.
- Marketplace: we generally prefer direct vendor contracts for anything over $50k ARR but will consider marketplace if the procurement team confirms budget routing.
- Questionnaire: yes, we have a security questionnaire; I attached a short checklist we use. Can you confirm who can complete the security fields?

Can we schedule the procurement sync on Friday 10/08 at 10am PT? That works for procurement.

Tom
Director, Procurement | Clearview Analytics
procurement@clearview.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Tom / Procurement — Alex here, ops lead. Quick answers and what we'll bring to the call: 

- Contracting: we have a standard Master Services Agreement + SOW; I attached the SOW draft Ben referenced. If Clearview has redlines, upload to DocuSign or share a marked PDF and we'll review.
- Marketplace: here's the marketplace listing link you can share with finance (small text file attached in Ben's original thread contains the URL). If procurement prefers marketplace billing, we will confirm pricing parity and any marketplace fees.
- Security questionnaire: Irene will own completion of the security checklist and can send the supporting evidence (SOC2 report) after we get an NDA or mutual non-disclosure if needed.

I'll plan to join Friday's sync. If the team prefers earlier, we can do tomorrow afternoon as well.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@clearview.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@clearview.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Tom — thanks for the checklist. I'll take point on the security questions. A couple of clarifying notes before the Friday sync so we can be efficient: 

1) PO timing: can you share Clearview's typical lead time between receiving a signed contract + W-9 and issuing a PO? That helps us set expectations for start date.
2) Marketplace vs direct: if procurement confirms direct PO, we will prioritize SOW redlines. If marketplace is preferred, we will enumerate any connector/setup steps we need on our side.
3) Required evidence: I'll attach our SOC2 cover letter and a redacted report summary on the call. If procurement requires the full SOC2 report, we'll need a signed NDA; can procurement confirm preferred path?

Attachment notes: uploading Redwood_SOW-draft-20261004.pdf (same draft Ben sent).

Proposed Friday agenda (10/08, 10am PT):
- 10m introductions & goals
- 15m vendor onboarding checklist (W-9, bank details, tax forms)
- 20m contract & SOW items (key terms, start date, trial/credits)
- 15m security questionnaire timeline & evidence handoff

If we don't get redlines by Wednesday EOD (10/07), I propose we run the call but mark the SOW as "provisionally accepted" pending legal redlines — this will keep schedule momentum.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Team — friendly nudge ahead of Friday's sync. Quick status so procurement knows where things stand: 

- Contract/SOW: draft attached and we've not yet received redlines. If legal needs more time, please tell us where it's stuck (legal review / budget approval / vendor setup).
- PO timing: Tom, if your team can share approximate lead time it helps lock in kickoff date.
- Marketplace option: Alex will standby to confirm whether marketplace billing is feasible if procurement requests it.

Proposed next steps: 
1) If procurement cannot provide redlines by Wed EOD, we still run Friday's call but mark the SOW provisioning note Irene suggested.
2) Procurement to confirm required finance contact and whether W-9 will be sent to procurement or directly to our finance team (finance@redwood.ai).

If useful, we can convert this into a brief mutual action plan doc and circulate after Friday's call. Want to keep momentum — are we good to keep the 10/08 10am PT slot?

Best,
Ben
